text:
alex: Morning—noticed a sharp uptick in DNS resolution failures from edge GPU pools since ~09:12 UTC. ~20% of pods reporting "SERVFAIL" / timeouts when resolving model-registry domains.

maria: Logs?

alex: Snippet from node-gtw-3 logs:
```bash
[09:12:05] resolv: lookup registry.prod.redwood: dial udp 10.0.0.2:53: i/o timeout
[09:12:06] resolver error: connection reset by peer
```
Seen from 3 AZs.

sachin: Any config changes around 09:10?

alex: infra-bot shows prober-config rollout at 09:08 — probe rate increased from 1r/min to 10r/min for edge-resolvers. I rolled prober-v2 earlier.

infra-bot: deployment prober-config v2 rolled to canary at 09:08, promoted to all at 09:09 (rollout policy: fast).

maria: That'd create a lot more UDP queries from every node -> possible SNAT ephemeral port exhaustion. We had a similar signature last month.

eve: Also saw conntrack table grow on the node pool and kube-proxy CPU spike.

sachin: Checked NAT metrics: concurrent SNAT entries hit hard limit, lots of src-port collisions and retransmits -> packets dropped.

alex: Timeline lines up: increased probe volume after rollout -> >65k ephemeral port churn across nodes -> SNAT collisions -> UDP resets -> resolver errors -> model fetch failures -> GPU pod restarts and provisioning churn.

maria: Mitigation options?

sachin: Immediate: rollback probe rate to 1r/min, add jitter/backoff to probes, enable DNS TCP fallback on resolvers. Medium-term: per-node SNAT pools or enlarge port range, tune conntrack timeouts, and add a rollout guard (rate*nodes cap).

eve: I'm rolling the rollback now.

infra-bot: rollback initiated by @eve at 09:18 UTC.

alex: After rollback, resolver error rate dropped back to baseline within ~45s. GPU provisioning churn stopped. Incident mitigated.

maria: Action items:
- revert default probe rate in helm values (owner: maria)
- add rollout guard that caps aggregate probe QPS (owner: maria)
- enable TCP fallback and increase cache TTL for model-registry domains (owner: sachin)
- doc SNAT port sizing & conntrack guidance for edge pools (owner: infra)

infra-bot: created issue: https://git.redwood/infra/issues/4824 - "edge-dns-prober-rate-surge"

eve: We'll assemble a short postmortem in #postmortems after we pull metrics and timelines. :thumbsup:
